title: Kissed Light Saudi Arabian Lamb Flatbread
description: A light and flavorful Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb and chives, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This fermented flatbread is made with a laminated puff pastry crust.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, chopped chives, flour, yeast, and salt.
Gradually add the water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Roll out the dough into a thin sheet.
Place the puff pastry sheet on top of the dough and brush with melted butter.
Fold the dough over the puff pastry to create a laminated crust.
Place the flatbread on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
